correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md:44–64, the row for edge uv of the multiplication matrix is the equation a_u b_v+a_v b_u=0. Coordinates outside N[S] are free; each coordinate in N[S]\S is forced to vanish by an incident supported endpoint. Dividing b_v by a_v on S reduces the internal equations to y_u=−y_v. Along a connected component one value propagates with parity of path length; an odd cycle kills it except in characteristic two, where every component allows one constant. This gives exactly (1) including isolated and empty supports, and counting coefficients gives (2). On a proper nonempty cycle support, each zero run of length l contributes min(l,2) vertices to N[S] and corresponds to one supported component, giving |S| plus one per zero run of length at least two. The three states are the preceding zero suffix length truncated at two; their cyclic path is unique for each labelled support, including the all-zero loop at the two-zero state and the all-one loop at the one-symbol state. The latter needs exactly the correction based on parity and characteristic. The determinant of lambda I−T is lambda³−(1+wz)lambda²+wz(1−z), proving (4) also at j=0 by Cayley–Hamilton. Both C5 examples agree by counting supports of each size. Static inspection of verify.py:151–191 and VERIFICATION.md:19–23 confirms modular and F4 rank comparisons in 15 cycle/field cases and two all-four-vertex-graphs suites. These are finite diagnostics, not used for the proof.

evidence: A=z M(w,1/z) has rows (1,z,0,0), (0,0,w,w), (z,z,0,0), (0,0,wz,wz). The last two columns coincide. On quotient coordinates (x1,x2,x3+x4) its induced matrix B has rows (1,z,0), (0,0,w), (z,z,wz). The killed line spanned by e3−e4 contributes zero to each positive-power trace. The determinant of lambda I−B is precisely lambda³−(1+wz)lambda²+wz(1−z).

B and the frozen T have the same characteristic polynomial and hence identical power traces in all degrees as 3×3 matrices. At degree zero the relevant trace for the recurrence is 3, not the unreduced trace 4.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Thus the prior four-state trace converts to a three-state trace and exactly the frozen cubic recurrence by a direct redundant-coordinate elimination, including the same full-support correction. The frozen proof interprets the reduced statistic with different states, but does not establish a new sequence or a lower recurrence order than is directly available from the earlier result.

originality.rationale: The distinct earlier October 12 Resultary finding proves the identical graph-support rank and identical cycle polynomial in nullity notation. Its four-state transfer also already implies the three-dimensional recurrence without a new enumerative argument: after converting nullity to rank two columns are equal, so the transfer descends by an explicit one-dimensional zero summand in the trace. The smaller matrix is an alternate presentation of this elementary reduction, not a materially distinct enumeration or recurrence.

value.rationale: The complete finite-field rank spectrum has mathematical use, but it and its constant-size computation are already available. The remaining improvement is a different three-state description of a matrix whose redundant dimension can be removed directly, with no new asymptotic efficiency, classification, or mathematical obstacle resolved. The explicit reduction shows why this is a small presentation change rather than an independent result warranting a repair.
